doc.brief: The possible values for the %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_STATE_INVALID accessible state.
doc.md:
The possible values for the %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_STATE_INVALID
accessible state.

Note that the %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_INVALID_FALSE and
%GTK_ACCESSIBLE_INVALID_TRUE have the same values
as `FALSE` and `TRUE`.

false.brief: There are no detected errors in the value
false.md: There are no detected errors in the value

true.brief: The value entered by the user has failed validation
true.md: The value entered by the user has failed validation
